text:
sara_ops: FYI vendor just flagged 12 H100s DOA in the incoming ETA wave. they can only replace 6 this week, rest are 2wk lead. need decision on loaners vs split shipments.
ranjit_procurement: ugh. which vendor and region?
SARA_OPS: edgecompute-supplies (APAC forwarder). they proposed partial replace + RMA for the damaged 6, remainder ships in ~14 days.
maya_infra: can we absorb latency if we route loaners from EU pool?
linus_logistics: customs risk if we split. could add 3-5 days. depot requires preflight image/firmware match.
sara_ops: vendor sent provisional manifest. pasting:
```
AWB: 123-AP-45678
SKU: H100-80GB
Qty: 12
RMA ref: EC-RMA-7890
ETA replacement: 14 days (partial 6 expedited)
```
ranjit_procurement: cost question — will vendor cover expedited air for the 6 DOA or do we?
sara_ops: vendor proposes 50% credit on expedited air, asks us to cover remainder. estimate ~$18k total air, so ~9k net.
jordan_finance: note that insurance and HS code will affect duties. pinging customs desk.
maya_infra: operational ask — we need serials asap to reconcile with our reserved pool and to avoid scheduling on those GPUs.
sara_ops: will attach CSV of serials. vendor also flagged 2 units with firmware mismatch (bad flash) and asked for checksum for validation.
maya_infra: checksum for current image: `sha256: d4f7a2b1c9e5f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6` — send to vendor ops.
linus_logistics: EU loaner pool has 10 H100s but 6 are earmarked for staging. can we shift staging for 48h?
maya_infra: yes, we can defer staging jobs for 48h. prefer loaners to avoid customs delay.
ranjit_procurement: draft reply to vendor: "We accept 6 loaners from EU pool; vendor to expedite remaining 6 with 50% air cost share; vendor must provide pre-paid return labels for DOA units; send serial list and firmware checksum."
sara_ops: sending that now + attaching serials.csv and staging hold note.
linus_logistics: note to depot: acceptance conditional on firmware checksum match and RMA paperwork. otherwise depot will quarantine units.
rma_bot: RMA created EC-RMA-7890, ticket 68291. Tracking: https://ship.track/123-AP-45678
ranjit_procurement: procurement will confirm cost-share and generate PO amendment for expedited charges.
jordan_finance: HS code suggested: 847141 (computing machinery). insurance premium will be added; expect small duty variance.
sara_ops: vendor also wants confirmation on who covers customs brokerage when splitting AWBs. vendor says they cover brokerage if full replace, but not if split.
linus_logistics: if we split, brokerage usually billed to consignee. that's us unless vendor explicitly covers.
ranjit_procurement: tell vendor we accept 50% air but they must provide return labels + cover brokerage for the DOA pieces.
sara_ops: sent. awaiting vendor ack. :thumbsup:
rma_bot: Update 15:24 UTC — vendor acknowledged 6 loaners from EU pool and 50% air cost share. Vendor will provide return labels and preflight firmware images.
maya_infra: once loaners are inbound, we'll run `redwoodctl models mark-degraded --model H100 --serial-file rma_serials.csv` to avoid scheduling.
linus_logistics: remind depot to capture photos on receipt and run quick acceptance script: `./depot_accept.sh --awb 123-AP-45678 --check-firmware`.
sara_ops: thanks all — will update if vendor revises terms or customs flags come up.
ranjit_procurement: will update procurement tracker and cost sheet.
jordan_finance: will pre-approve up to $10k for expedited air pending final invoice.
sara_ops: closing loop for now, reconvene if vendor pushes for different terms.
